notes.title: Demo V0.55 Updata Note
notes.content: [h3]Difficulty Adjustment[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new "Hard" difficulty level. The new difficulty tiers are: Easy, Standard, Hard, and Chieftain.[/p][/*][*][p]"Hard" is easier than the previous "Chieftain", while the new "Chieftain" is more challenging than before.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Improved Building Pushing Interaction[/h3][list][*][p]Slightly increased the pushing distance between buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sand and dust effects when pushing.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Content and Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Double Cannon[/b]: Attack speed from 1 → 0.85[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scatter[/b]: Cooldown from 18 → 24[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mortar[/b]: Damage from 32 → 36[/p][/*][*][p][b]Allied Towers[/b]: Required towers from 15 → 10[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spearman[/b]: Frenzy after 5 attacks → Frenzy after staying on the battlefield for a while[/p][/*][*][p][b]1-6 Unlock[/b]: Expansion Prep → Crystal Research[/p][/*][*][p][b]2-A Unlock[/b]: Snowball Spell → Icebreaker[/p][/*][*][p][b]2-A Unlock[/b]: Crystal Research → Glass Cannon[/p][/*][/list][h3]Challenge Mode Rule Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Stages 1-6 and 2-4 now require mandatory blueprint and rune selections.[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 2-2 challenge now increases Orc HP by 50%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Allied Towers[/b] sometimes didn’t activate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text overflow in the English "Thank You" popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Flamethrower still making sounds when sound effects are disabled.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added a new "Hard" difficulty level. The new difficulty tiers are: Easy, Standard, Hard, and Chieftain.

tags.balance_change: "Hard" is easier than the previous "Chieftain", while the new "Chieftain" is more challenging than before.
Slightly increased the pushing distance between buildings.

tags.feature: Added sand and dust effects when pushing.

tags.balance_change: Spearman: Frenzy after 5 attacks → Frenzy after staying on the battlefield for a while
Stage 2-2 challenge now increases Orc HP by 50%.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Allied Towers sometimes didn’t activate.
Fixed text overflow in the English "Thank You" popup.
Fixed the Flamethrower still making sounds when sound effects are disabled.
